en: A crunchy baguette extravagantly arranged with the sea's bounty.
Fresh seafood cooked in a thick white sauce and baked to perfection in a golden-brown pie shell.
Enjoy these crispy fried chicken wings with drinks.
Enjoy this old standard as a starter.
Deep-fried golden brown and smothered in Nagoya's famous miso. This is Kaburaya's version of a Nagoya classic.
Our house-special charcoal grilled spare ribs are big, meaty, and guaranteed to please.
Ground Nagoya Cochin chicken is wrapped in daifuku mochi and bathed in a delicious dashi stock.
Eel is prepared the Nagoya way in this famous dish.
The nostalgic flavor of yonaki noodles has been updated with the taste of curry.
This superb salad combines healthy vegetables and deliciously slurpable Korean noodles.
The secret of our hit salad is in its special dressing and fresh ingredients.
These plump clams are shipped directly from Morozaki, Aichi. You'll love their firm texture.
These eel backbones are fried at a low temperature until they are nice and crispy.
This union of warm sweet potato and ice cream is a major hit with the ladies. Enjoy its rich, creamy taste.
Our own original shochu, made in Kagoshima.
We recommend you try the Kaburaya take on the traditional highball at least once.
A mug full of wine and ice. It's a new way to enjoy wine.
Drink up! You'll only be charged for how much you down.
You can't say Nagoya without thinking about tebasaki chicken wings. Ours go great with beer.
Everyone knows about this Nagoya classic. Nothing's better when you're hungry.
These flat udon noodles are a staple food in Nagoya. The dried bonito flavor of the soup base is out of this world.
This recent addition to the Nagoya food scene features fat noodles and is very filling.
Glass after glass, you'll never tire of this one.
This extravagant drink features freshly squeezed grapefruit juice.
This is a real man's highball made with dry whisky and dry ginger.
This single-malt whisky's complexity and depth come from the distillery's multiple sets of copper pot stills.
This single-malt whisky was born at the crossroads of tradition and revolution.
Everyone from kids to adults loves to drink oolong tea.
This nonalcoholic beer has a refreshing taste and goes down smooth.
You'll love this smooth, easy-to-drink alcoholic beverage. It has just a hint of refreshing carbonation.
This turmeric drink is only sold at Hanako. Its pineapple flavor makes it easy to drink, even for those who can't stand turmeric.
Freshly caught and shipped straight from the waters off Hokkaido, this mackerel offers a deep flavor.
This simple, deeply flavorful dish wouldn't be possible without the sweet onions we have shipped straight from local Hokkaido farms.
Flavorful and broiled to perfection. Enjoy with mayonnaise, the standard condiment for this dish.
Slowly cured and then grilled to perfection. A taste explosion awaits you with every bite.
Thick, al dente noodles are mixed with a special soy sauce-based, sesame-flavored sauce in this menu favorite.
Zangi is the word for karaage in Hokkaido. You won't be able to resist this meaty, juicy fried chicken.
Made with thigh meat from chickens raised in Shiretoko, Hokkaido, and paired with a hearty tartar sauce that's a perfect match.
Tender kalbi cut from beef bones and grilled up with a special sauce. Eat it right off a sizzling griddle.
This fried udon is a Hanako original. Its special blend of yummy spices will leave you wondering why no one thought of it before!
In this classic barbeque dish, shoulder meat from lambs less than a year old is marinated in our secret sauce.
We hand trim the lamb leg in this favorite to remove excess fat, leaving only the tender, juicy meat.
This is the pinnacle of Matsuo Lamb Barbeque dishes. Each lamb only produces about 700g of the meat used in this dish.
Our chef's special has three condiments (snow wasabi, yuzu pepper, and Genki eggs) combined for a brand new taste.
Rib meat, the tenderest cut of lamb, is marinated in our special sauce and grilled to perfection. It's thick, juicy, and tender!
This big, meaty sausage has a nice snap on the outside and is packed with juicy meat on the inside.
Enjoy this udon cooked on the perimeter of the barbeque skillet, where meat juices and our secret sauce form a tasty union.
This healthy salad is packed with seaweed and lightly seasoned with taste bud-tantalizing sesame seed salt.
A juicy filling of vegetables and meat is wrapped in aged dough wrappers and fried to a nice crisp. Eat them piping hot.
Piping hot gyoza with white rice. This hit menu item also comes with miso soup and all-you-can-eat freshly pickled vegetables.
Eighteen gyoza, a large bowl of rice, and miso soup. Guaranteed to satisfy even the biggest of appetites.
Miyoshino's rich and slightly spicy curry is made with fresh vegetables and thinly sliced meat for that homemade flavor people love.
Curry topped with three crispy fried shrimp. This one's quite popular with the ladies.
Our famous curry topped with our house-special gyoza. This delectable combination has been a customer favorite since 1977.
Our famous curry topped with shredded cheese. The richness of the curry goes perfectly with the mellowness of the cheese.
Who doesn't like a big old plate of curry rice with a handmade, crispy fried cutlet at a reasonable price?
An extra large serving of curry rice topped with six gyoza and a soft-boiled egg. A great choice for those with a big appetite.
Our number one menu item comes with gyoza, curry, and freshly pickled vegetables. Eat the gyoza as a topping or on the side.
This big dish comes with curry rice topped with one long, juicy, handmade sausage packed with coarsely ground meat.
Enjoy our miso ramen with its rich, deep soup. It's practically synonymous with the name Sumire.
Features our rich soup and carefully selected tamari soy sauce that goes great with it.
Made with natural salt that allows the soup's flavor to shine through.
This soup's aroma will take you way back to when this style of ramen was all the rage.
This rice bowl is topped with a shredded egg omelet and spicy fish roe steeped in Sumire miso.
Sumire's special fried rice is lavishly prepared with huge chunks of roast pork.
Beautifully translucent and deliciously seasoned with spices that perfectly match our Japanese dashi stock.
A generous portion of Hokkaido vegetables are cut thick and added to our house-special curry soup.
This extravagant menu item allows you to enjoy both chicken and vegetable curry soup if you can't decide which one to order.
Pakistani-style curry that adds plenty of fruits, vegetables, and spices to a slowly sautéed onion base.
This limited-time only menu item features local seafood in our chicken and vegetable curry soup. Taste the goodness of Hokkaido!
If you can't decide between curry and curry soup, why not have both? This well-priced set also includes salad and dessert.
What drink goes better with curry than a lassi? Enjoy the natural flavor of yogurt sweetened with honey.
This lassi features honeyberries, a special product of Hokkaido. They are packed with vitamins that your body needs.
This is Gyoza King's namesake and masterpiece! Our individually handmade gyoza are fried crispy outside, juicy inside.
An old standard with egg, sliced roast pork, green onions, and rice fried up with amazing spices that ramp up the flavor.
Kimchi is added to our standard fried rice for a spiciness that whets the appetite and leaves you wanting more.
This addictively delicious dish features egg and crab meat cooked together and topped with your choice of sauce.
This dish features a sauce made with a special soup of flavorful seafood and vegetables.
Gyoza King's special soup made from slow-simmered pork bone stock and soy sauce make for a perfect bowl of ramen.
Plenty of healthy vegetables, al dente noodles, and our special flavorful sauce make this yakisoba out of this world.
Pork and vinegar make this dish tasty and healthy. The colorful vegetables and pork are a sight to see, and a delight to eat.
These juicy meatballs fried in sweet vinegar will leave you wanting more of their sweet-and-sour goodness.
This dish is packed with fresh, crunchy vegetables and the bounty of the sea. A thick, steaming ankake sauce seals the deal.
Sweet, plump shrimp and a spicy chili sauce are a match made in heaven. Goes perfectly with bowl after bowl of rice.
Crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside. Comes with a salt-and-spice mix that you can sprinkle on to taste.
Fried up fresh, these chicken wings make a great snack or the centerpiece of an entire meal.
This luxurious, flavorful new twist on Napolitan pasta replaces sausage with salsiccia and mushrooms with porcini.
This Korean tofu stew masterpiece brings together sweet seafood, rich shellfish, and exquisite sauce Américaine.
The sweetness of slow-fried onions and the deep flavor of minced chicken are ramped up with special spices.
The heat of aged broad bean chili paste shines through in this East-West mashup. Japanese beef fat adds extra richness.
This masterpiece is simple yet irresistible. The beautiful flavor of eggs and milk is accentuated with aromatic vanilla beans.
This rice soup turns stew-like with the addition of white sauce and black pepper. Enjoy it carbonara style with an egg on top.
